tasks.instructions: The graph below gives information on the numbers of participants for different activities at one social centre in Melbourne, Australia for the period 2000 to 2020. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

visual_data.title: Numbers of participants for different activities
visual_data.description: Line graph tracking five activities from 2000 to 2020. Film club remained the most popular, consistently staying above 60 participants. Table tennis grew sharply to become the second most popular by 2020. Martial arts fluctuated around 30-35, while amateur dramatics declined to the lowest spot. Musical performances began in 2005 and rose steadily.

tasks.instructions: The plans below show a harbour in 2000 and how it looks today. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

visual_data.title: Porth Harbour (in 2000)
visual_data.description: Original layout of Porth Harbour. Western main road connects to two car parks. The northern car park and showers/toilets are adjacent to a Marina (private yachts). The southern car park is adjacent to Fishing boats. A road leads east past a Lifeboat station to a disused Castle on a peninsula, bordered by a southern Public beach. The central water area contains a Dock with Passenger ferries, and a northern Public beach.

visual_data.title: Porth Harbour (today)
visual_data.description: Modernized layout showing commercial development. The Marina and Fishing boats have swapped locations; Fishing boats are now north, while the Marina is south with its own new car park and showers/toilets. Cafés & shops have been added next to the Lifeboat station. The disused Castle has been converted into a Hotel, and the southern Public beach is now a Private beach for the hotel. The central dock now accommodates an additional passenger ferry.

tasks.instructions: The diagram below shows how a biofuel called ethanol is produced. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

visual_data.title: Biofuel production: how ethanol is made
visual_data.description: A cyclical process diagram detailing both the production of ethanol and its continuous carbon cycle. The sequence is: 1) Plants and trees grow by absorbing energy (sunlight and carbon dioxide). 2) The plants are harvested. 3) They undergo pre-processing to extract cellulose. 4) The cellulose undergoes chemical processing to be converted into sugars. 5) Microbes are added to the sugars to produce Ethanol. 6) The ethanol is used as fuel for transportation (cars, trucks, airplanes). 7) These vehicles emit carbon dioxide as exhaust. 8) The carbon dioxide returns to the atmosphere, where it is absorbed again by growing plants, thereby completing the cycle.

tasks.instructions: The charts below give information on the location and types of dance classes young people in a town in Australia are currently attending. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant. Write at least 150 words.

visual_data.title: Location of dance classes
visual_data.description: A pie chart showing four locations for dance classes: Private studios make up nearly half at 48%. This is followed by School halls (after-school) at 24%, Community halls & other at 18%, and College-based studios at exactly 10%.

visual_data.title: Types of dance classes (by age group)
visual_data.description: A horizontal bar chart comparing the number of students in Ballet, Tap, and Modern dance across two age groups (Under 11, and 11-16). Key comparisons: Ballet is overwhelmingly popular with the Under 11 group (exactly 600 students) compared to the 11-16 group (approx. 300). Modern dance shows the reverse trend, being more popular with the 11-16 group (approx. 520 students) than the Under 11 group (approx. 300). Tap dance has relatively similar participation across both age groups (approx. 450 for Under 11, and 420 for 11-16).
